verdict.rationale: Missive explicitly supports assigning conversations to a team or specific person while maintaining visibility (missive-docs-6), shared team inboxes/distribution lists (missive-docs-32), and up to 1000 automation rules for routing workflows (missive-docs-36, missive-docs-11/25), directly matching the assignment + rule-routing story. Every action is logged for accountability (missive-docs-9), reinforcing explicit ownership. Missing for 10: no independent/hands-on evidence or detailed documentation of the rule-builder's conditional logic (e.g., routing by sender/keyword) beyond the pricing page mention of rule count.
